Admin Insights overview, sentiment bar (17% positive / 55% neutral / 28% negative), themes chips, and all 4 category cards present (admin-insights-cat-missing_features / -problems / -nice_to_have / -praise) with item titles + mention counts.

Pro header bell badge shows '9+' confirming notifications system renders in nav.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_insights_routes.py header docstring still says 'GPT-5.4-mini via the Emergent universal key' but MODEL_NAME is 'gpt-5-mini' - docstring should be updated to avoid confusion (gpt-5.4-mini isn't available on the proxy).

pm_routes.py apply_template silently skips milestone payment creation when pro.bank_iban is missing (payments_created=0). Consider returning a soft warning in the response so the UI can hint to the pro to set IBAN. Currently the response only carries counts.

/api/pm/barcode-lookup depends on third-party UPCitemdb free trial which is rate-limited; failure is swallowed (returns found=False). That's correct UX but consider logging rate-limit responses for ops visibility.

_notify_homeowner_co_sent / _notify_homeowner_payment_requested swallow all exceptions silently - if push registration breaks, in-app bell still works but pros wouldn't get visibility. Good enough for now; consider structured logging.
pm_routes.py is 1878 lines and crossing the maintainability threshold (>700); consider splitting templates/materials/payments/notifications into sibling modules for next refactor pass.
